name: Tower of Gloom
source:
From cradle to grave, once ripped from the womb
Decades of life, spent trapped in this room
Steady, unchanging, the future dost loom
If only the past had not sealed your doom
Now'days, spent drinking and inhaling fumes
Til flesh rots off, and your bones exhumed
But open another, for death will come soon
dullachan.itch.io/tower-of-gloom/
translation:
从摇篮到坟墓，一旦从子宫中被撕裂
几十年的人生，被困在这个房间里度过
稳健不变，未来已然来临
如果过去没有注定你的厄运就好了
如今，喝酒、吸入烟雾
直到肉腐烂，骨头被挖出来
但再打开一个，因为死亡很快就会到来dullachan.itch.io/阴暗之塔/
